# YooshMD

> Physician-led telehealth medical weight loss program. Board-certified obesity medicine specialist providing semaglutide, tirzepatide, and physician-oversight care via telehealth in California, Nevada, and Florida.

YooshMD is run by Darius Roohani, MD — double board-certified in Internal Medicine and Obesity Medicine, trained at Cedars-Sinai and the University of Nevada, Reno School of Medicine. One physician personally manages every patient's care directly: no call center, no rotating providers. YooshMD is a self-pay practice and does not bill insurance; self-pay allows uninterrupted, personalized care.

## Pricing

- Semaglutide Program: from $220/month, compounded semaglutide included, price scales with prescribed dose ($220–$290/month across 0.5mg–2.5mg).
- Tirzepatide Program: from $260/month, compounded tirzepatide included, price scales with prescribed dose ($260–$400/month across 2.5mg–15mg).
- Physician Oversight: $199 per visit, billed quarterly. Medication cost not included. For patients using brand-name Wegovy®, Zepbound®, or Ozempic®, oral GLP-1 options, or non-GLP-1 treatment.
- Initial consultation: free 30-minute video visit with Dr. Roohani, no obligation to continue.
- Billing: monthly-program patients receive a line-item invoice covering that month's treatment and medication; Physician Oversight patients are charged per visit. There are no automatic recurring/subscription charges beyond each invoice or visit.
- Refunds: shipped medications are non-refundable. Visit fees are refundable if cancelled within 24 hours of the appointment time.

## Service Area

Telehealth only, for patients physically located in California, Nevada, or Florida at the time of their visit.
